name: University for the Creative Arts
description: The University for the Creative Arts is a specialised public university for arts and design located in the United Kingdom. UCA is the second largest provider of creative arts education in the UK and has four campuses in Canterbury, Epsom, Farnham, and Rochester. UCA offers undergraduate, graduate and postgraduate courses in a wide range of subjects ranging from fine art, animation, business, music and photography. The university has a number of centres such as the Animation Research Centre, Centre for Digital Scholarship, Crafts Study Centre and several other research clusters to further its academic research. UCA is ranked #13 out of all universities in the UK by the Guardian and is the highest ranked arts university in all the UK rankings.
